ITEM 1 | Pale golden-tan cubes with browned, slightly crisp outer edges and a soft, fluffy interior, roughly 3 cm chunks, upper-left of plate, sitting near other roasted pieces; matte, dry-looking surface | 95
ITEM 2 | Bright orange cubes with smooth flesh and slightly translucent edges, roughly 2 to 2.5 cm pieces with flat cut faces, lower-left of plate, moist-looking and firm | 85
ITEM 3 | Dark brown, glossy roasted chunks with uneven browned surfaces, roughly 2.5 cm, center-left of plate beside the orange cubes, appear slightly sticky with a glaze-like sheen | 55
ITEM 4 | Cauliflower florets, creamy white with light golden-brown roasted spots and tips, florets about 2 to 3 cm across, scattered across upper-right of plate, firm and dry with some crumbly edges | 60
ITEM 5 | Scrambled-looking pale yellow and orange-tinged egg curds, soft and moist with a slight sheen, in irregular clumps about 3 to 4 cm, lower-right of plate, mixed with bits of cauliflower | 70
